# Doc Miller Sports

> > Doc Miller Sports specializes in medical-grade compression wear including socks, sleeves, and braces for athletic recovery and injury support across all body parts.

Doc Miller Sports offers a comprehensive catalog of compression garments designed for both medical recovery and athletic performance. The product line features various compression levels (measured in mmHg) and styles to address specific body areas and user preferences.

## Key Topics

- Compression Socks
- Compression Sleeves
- mmHg Compression Levels
- Medical Grade
- Athletic Recovery
- Open Toe vs Closed Toe
- Calf Compression
- Knee Braces
- Ankle Support
- Elbow Compression
- 20-30 mmHg
- 15-20 mmHg
- Sports Recovery
- Men's & Women's Sizing
- Doc Miller Brand
